title: flow-trace Flow document
description: Object model for the Flow mode (high-level, abstract view). A single *.flow.json file is one Flow document. The Trace mode (low-level) extends this in a later schema version with source refs, request/response and params.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor/IDE validation. Ignored by flow-trace.

version.description: Schema version of this document, for migrations.

id.description: Identity of THIS flow. Workspace-unique. Stable, scoped id (e.g. 'transaction-create'), not a display label.

title.description: Human-readable title of the flow (display only).

layout.description: Auto-layout direction. TB = top-to-bottom, LR = left-to-right.

overview.description: Optional document-level overview — general information about this flow, as paragraphs (one per array item). Shown in the bottom Overview bar.

actors.description: Owners/participants. Every participant, human AND system. Each node references one actor as its owner (drives node color + legend).

scopedId.description: Stable, scoped identifier: lowercase alphanumerics with '.', '_' or '-' as separators (e.g. 'txn.charge', 'charge-detail'). This is identity, NOT the display label.

kind.description: Nature of the participant. human = external user/operator; system = external system/remote API; service = internal component/service; infra = database/queue/cache.

color.description: Optional explicit node color for this actor (hex). If omitted, an auto-palette is used that avoids red/green as accidental success/error signals.

id.description: Node identity. By DEFAULT file-local (per-flow): the same id in two different flow files does NOT collide — flows are isolated namespaces. Set 'shared': true to flip this id into the workspace-global namespace.

type.description: terminal = flow start/end (capsule); step = action (rounded rect); decision = branch/if (diamond); subflow = drills down into another flow (double-border + ⊕); io = data in/out (parallelogram).

label.description: Display text (e.g. 'Charge payment'). Two nodes may share a label as long as their ids differ — the system never confuses them.

owner.description: Reference to actors[].id — who performs this step. Drives node color. Optional for type:terminal.

description.description: What this step does, as a LIST OF POINTS — one thesis per array element (rendered as bullets). Required, at least one point. Detail depth is the author's call, guided by the user and flow-trace://guide. Do NOT cram multiple theses into one string; split them into separate items.

source.description: Optional — a code reference for this step (file / symbol / line).

refs.description: Optional — external documents/links (useful when describing a global system rather than concrete code).

shared.description: Opt-in cross-flow identity (the hybrid model). When true, this node's id lives in the workspace-global namespace: the same shared id in other flows refers to the SAME object (enables cross-flow tracing/consistency). Default false = per-flow local.

subflow.description: For type:subflow only — the id of the flow that this node drills down into (optional depth / nested mode).

sequence.description: Optional drill-down into a Sequence document (low-level execution sequence) describing how this step runs. Opened the same way as a subflow.

edge.description: A directed connection. An edge is a first-class object like a node: it may carry the same optional content (description, inputs/outputs, source, refs) and drill down into a sub-flow describing how the transition happens.

id.description: Optional edge identity. Lives in the SAME object-id namespace as nodes (must be unique across nodes+edges in this flow). Required only if you select/drill/share this edge. Set 'shared': true to make it workspace-global like a shared node.

type.description: flow = next step (solid arrow); branch = labeled exit from a decision (solid arrow + label); return = return/loop back (dashed curved arrow).

label.description: Edge label. Primarily for type:branch (the condition, e.g. 'yes' / 'amount > 0').

description.description: Optional — what happens during this transition, as a LIST OF POINTS (one thesis per item, rendered as bullets). Unlike a node's description this is optional.

inputs.description: Optional — what flows across this edge.

source.description: Optional — a code reference for this transition (file / symbol / line).

refs.description: Optional — external documents/links for this transition.

shared.description: Opt-in cross-flow identity (same as a node's). When true, this edge's id is workspace-global: the same shared id elsewhere refers to the SAME object. Requires id. Default false.

subflow.description: Optional drill-down — the id of a flow that describes the full process of getting from 'from' to 'to'. Opened the same way as a subflow node.

sequence.description: Optional drill-down into a Sequence document (low-level execution sequence) for this transition.
